psychological_meaning: Caribbean Green evokes feelings of tranquility, balance, and rejuvenation. It blends the calming properties of blue with the growth and renewal associated with green, creating a sense of harmony and peace. This color often represents nature, health, and well-being, promoting a feeling of freshness and vitality.
